category_fix_note: Was taxonomy_id 266 / category 'other' -- scripts/gumroad_publish.mjs never set a taxonomy_id at creation, so Gumroad defaulted it there. Confirmed as a real defect via scripts/gumroad_listing_diagnostics.mjs, then fixed via scripts/gumroad_fix_category.mjs (PUT /v2/products/:id, taxonomy_id=85) after fetching Gumroad's real category tree live (GET /v2/categories) and confirming the update mechanism against Gumroad's own production source. Verified changed via an independent re-fetch, not just the PUT response.
